jobs.prompt: Crimson Court Blood Elf town at night beneath a vast red moon; black-marble palace terraces, obsidian towers, blood-red crystal windows, living crimson thorn gardens and Bloodwood, bridge and ceremonial court in foreground, clear buildable midground silhouettes, distant spires; elegant ancient aristocracy, not demonic; composition designed for a Heroes III town screen with readable building zones.

Tier-1 Veinling, young Blood Elf court initiate, lean pale figure, dark fitted ceremonial leather, small crimson crystal accents, ritual scar motifs without gore, short blade, wary predatory stance; simple readable silhouette suitable for tiny turn-based strategy battle sprite.

Bloodbound upgrade of Veinling, disciplined Blood Elf initiate, same lineage and proportions but stronger dark segmented armour, crimson oath bindings and crystal clasp, sharper blade, controlled aggressive stance; visibly upgraded while preserving base-unit silhouette.

Tier-2 Thorn Dancer, agile Blood Elf duelist, elegant pale aristocrat, black-and-burgundy light armour, curved thorn-blade and living crimson thorn ribbon motif, dancer-like combat stance, long readable limbs and weapon arc; dangerous elegance, not bulky.

Crimson Dancer upgrade, master Blood Elf thorn duelist, ceremonial black armour with refined blood-red crystal filigree, stronger thorn-ribbon weapon arc, poised lethal dance stance; upgrade reads as precision and prestige rather than heavier armour.

Vaelor, Bloodlord hero portrait, severe male Blood Elf martial aristocrat, pale skin, dark hair, restrained black plate and burgundy cloak, small blood-red crystal insignia, intelligent commanding expression, ancient court background, strong face silhouette at small UI scale.

Aveline, Sanguine Seer hero portrait, female Blood Elf arcane aristocrat, pale complexion, silver-white hair, dark ceremonial robes and armour, restrained crimson crystal divination ornaments, calm unsettling gaze, red-moon court background, readable face at small UI scale.
